answer: The quarry bench stands stepped in the hillside, stone faces marked for the cut. spiral drills the holes along the chalk line and sets the wedges. Proof of quarrier via hewn block tally — a block the quarrier hews only after 1033 blocks hew true without one face cracking at the seam, each hewn by the quarrier himself. lotus strikes the wedges in turn and listens for the crack. wharf levers the block free and squares it with the hammer. One thousand and thirty-three blocks must hew true without one face cracking at the seam, and the next still cracks where the stone hid a fault.
